label: 🐀 Feral (0.7 beta)
description:
Nine noisy, unpredictable synthesis models on one machine, light on the processor.

[[video]]

NYB - Nyblcore: bytebeat formulas over an 8 kHz counter
GND - Gendy: per-period waveform from random-walk points
BNJ - Benjolin: two triangles plus an 8-bit rungler clocked by OSC2
RYT - Rhythmicon: ten partials as 2-pole ping resonators
FRS - Fourses: four points reflecting between neighbors, averaged
RNG - Rungler: 8-bit register quantized to fifths/octaves
PLS - Pulsar: windowed sine pulses at COLOR × pitch
SCN - Scanned synthesis: 32-mass ring scanned at note pitch
KOS - Chaotic map: x → r·x(1−x), 16 iterations per period

[GATE] = on (with extended note lengths) is recommended for all synthesis types

[PUNCH] is an on/off "FREE" switch.
Off: each trig restarts the engine from scratch, so every hit sounds the same.
On: the engine keeps running between trigs, so patterns drift and change on their own.
On BNJ: it locks the random loop into a repeating cycle instead of letting it wander.
